title: Profile: DIDComm ciphertext translator (IO)
description:
Write a non-normative profile for an IO-side translator that carries Agora MLS ciphertext to MLS-capable DIDComm wallets without decrypting.

Scope:
- Map envelopes, Subscribe, and channel tokens onto DIDComm messages; the translator subscribes to relays on the wallet's behalf.
- Add a ServiceAgreement serviceType for the translator.
- Add an ARCHITECTURE §5 observation-budget entry (tokens carried, DIDComm endpoint, timing; comparable to a push proxy).
- Decide whether the wallet's own DIDComm mediator is treated as the user's network choice and kept outside Agora's observation budget (needs Mark's decision).
- KeyPackage and Welcome delivery stay on HTTPS KeyPackageEndpoint (dtg-openvtc.md §8 unchanged).

Rejected alternative: treating DIDComm mediators as relays (Agora cannot bind mediators it does not run). A plaintext DIDComm gateway remains possible under spec §9 / profiles/gateways.md for wallets without MLS.

Origin: IIW prep Q&A, notes/iiw-index-card.md.
